facts.fact: Clara 的内心战争：对 Ben 刚开始的感情 vs 对 Quint「压抑到发闷」的熟悉——他很久以前就拿走了她的心。
facts.anchor: But the feeling that I’ve known Quint far longer is almost oppressive. He took my heart long ago and kept it all my life.

facts.fact: Plaza 搜查 Ben 分工不让 Clara 参与——「你的专长是开门，这个是我的」，性别冲突爆发。
facts.anchor: “You brought us here,” he says, reaching to take me by the waist. “That’s your area of expertise, and this is mine.”

facts.fact: Clara 的讥讽反击：1928 年女性够不够聪明投票？Quint 聪明地不接话。
facts.anchor: “Remind me,” I say in a too-sweet voice, “are women deemed intelligent enough to vote yet?”

facts.fact: Quint 救场：搂腰带她离开，说「正找借口与你独处」。
facts.anchor: Quint again jumps in to rescue, this time sliding his arm around my waist and guiding me away.

facts.fact: Quint 说漏 Aunt Vi——他不该知道的人名；两人同时吓住。
facts.anchor: “Your Aunt Vi took good care of you, though,” Quint says gently

facts.fact: Quint 揭示：六岁那年被父母带去 The Villa 过夏，有个榛色眼睛深金发小女孩与他形影不离数周。
facts.anchor: “When I was six, my parents took me out west for the summer,” he says in a low voice

facts.fact: 1911 姓氏 Granville——意味着 Clara 的父母穿越过，或她小时候独自穿越；两种都比恋爱更离谱。
facts.anchor: It means that my parents time-traveled. Or that I somehow traveled on my own and was miraculously okay?

facts.fact: 亲吻如归乡：指尖、颈后、发间的动作她全「做过千百次」；Quint 说像「一辈子每天吻一次吻了六十年」。
facts.anchor: Our kiss is like a homecoming.

facts.fact: Ben 推断：穿越能力可能是遗传的；Clara 私心浮现——能否用镜子回到父母死前见一面？
facts.anchor: It would explain a great deal about your ability to travel through the passages if it’s hereditary

facts.fact: Clara 的母亲生前是 historical research consultant——替写书、广告、地产开发做历史研究。
facts.anchor: “People hired her to research things for them, for all sorts of reasons—writing books, creating advertisements, even research for property developments.

facts.fact: 池塘边 Quint 确认：「你是我母亲最好的朋友」——Clara 的前世/平行人生是 Isabelle Allen 的挚友。
facts.anchor: “You are my mother’s best friend,” he says into the silence

facts.fact: 睡美人歌词第三次出现：「You’ll love me at once」——Quint 应「Yes」，牵她回府（克制住吻）。
facts.anchor: “You’ll love me at once,” I whisper, a breath away from his lips.
